Copy its app-building / import / mock shape; do NOT modify it. The ticket's fix shape, quoted: "The exact change". The ticket-named cell must reach the defective code at line 480 of `services/referral/src/referral.openapi.ts` ("content: { 'application/json': { schema: ReferralCodeSchema } },") and assert the BEHAVIOUR the ticket describes — fix every site the ticket names inside the product file, not only the first.
